'''Krallys the Wild''' was the name of an [[Acklay/Legends|Acklay]] which escaped from the [[Coronet Zoo]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]] and was subsequently [[Death/Legends|killed]].

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Krallys appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Corellia. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
